CreateServiceLinkedRole.description_en: Creates a service-linked role for WUYING Workspace
CreateServiceLinkedRole.description_zh: 为云桌面创建服务关联角色

DescribeAvailableResource.description_en: Queries the specifications and zone list of Cloud Desktop clusters
DescribeAvailableResource.description_zh: 查看云桌面集群的规格与可用区列表

DescribeClusterADDomain.description_en: Queries the information about the Active Directory (AD) associated with a Cloud Desktop cluster
DescribeClusterADDomain.description_zh: 查询与云桌面集群的用户关联 AD 的信息

DescribeClusterConnections.description_en: Query session connection information for a cluster
DescribeClusterConnections.description_zh: 查询某集群的会话连接信息

DescribeClusters.description_en: Calls DescribeClusters to query cluster information

DescribeInstancePolicy.description_en: Retrieves the policy configuration status of an instance
DescribeInstancePolicy.description_zh: 攻取实例的策略配置状态

GetConnectTicket.description_en: Retrieves the token required to connect to an instance
GetConnectTicket.description_zh: 获取连接实例所需要的token

IsUserAdmin.description_en: Queries the permissions of the current user

SetClusterADDomain.description_en: Associates or dissociates a Cloud Desktop cluster with an Active Directory (AD) domain by calling SetClusterADDomain
SetClusterADDomain.description_zh: 调用SetClusterADDomain关联云桌面集群和AD域

SetClusterDnat.description_en: Associates a cluster with a NAT gateway. After the association, desktops are connected through DNAT and EIP
SetClusterDnat.description_zh: 将集群与网关（NAT）做关联，关联后将以 DNAT + EIP 的方式来连接桌面

SetClusterName.description_en: Sets the name of a cluster

SetClusterPolicy.description_en: Sets the policy for a cluster

SetImageName.description_en: Sets the name of an image

SetInstanceName.description_en: Sets the name of an instance

SetInstancePolicy.description_en: Sets the policy status of an instance

SetInstanceUser.description_en: Assigns a user to an instance
